'''Jaqueline Godoy Mesquita''' (born 1985) is a Brazilian mathematician specializing in [[differential equation]]s and [[functional differential equation]]s. She is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Brasília]].{{r|unb}}

==Education and career==
Mesquita was born on 20 September 1985.{{r|abc}} After graduating from the University of Brasília in 2007,{{r|abc}} she earned a Ph.D. at the [[University of São Paulo]] in 2012, with the dissertation ''Measure functional differential equations and impulsive functional dynamic equations on time scales'', jointly supervised by Marcia Cristina Anderson Braz Federson and Antonín Slavík,{{r|mg}} based in part on work as a visiting student at the [[Czech Academy of Sciences]].{{r|abc}}

After postdoctoral study at the University of São Paulo and the [[University of Santiago, Chile]], she became a professor at the University of Brasília in 2015.{{r|unb}}

==Recognition==
The International Society of Differential Equations gave Mesquita their Bernd Aulbach student prize in 2012.{{r|aulbach}}

Mesquita became an affiliate member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]] in 2018.{{r|abc}} She is also a young affiliate of [[The World Academy of Sciences]].{{r|twas}} She was a 2019 winner of the Brazilian [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards]].{{r|unesco}}

She is the current president of the [[Brazilian Mathematical Society]].
